deduplication_policy.cluster_scope: Cluster-based deduplication; only earliest observed publication in cluster can trigger veto
deduplication_policy.tie_breaker: Deterministic sort by (availability_time ASC, event_id ASC)

revision_handling.rule: If revision_observation_time > decision_cutoff, revised content is invisible at decision time; original state must be used

provenance_and_intraday_filters.rejected_source_rule: Events with provenance_status == REJECTED cannot trigger vetoes
provenance_and_intraday_filters.gdelt_intraday_prohibition: Events with source_id == 'gdelt_gkg' cannot trigger vetoes on intraday timeframes (15m, 1h, 4h)

verification_verdict: PASS WITH FULL EXECUTABLE ENGINE VERIFICATION
